skill.name: webask-results-sharing
skill.description: Готовит результаты опроса WebAsk для передачи другому человеку — публичную ссылку на отчёт, сводку или ответы, PDF или Word, умный отчёт с выводами. Применяется, когда человек просит прислать результаты заказчику, поделиться отчётом с коллегой, выгрузить итоги или собрать отчёт с выводами.
skill.summary: Prepare WebAsk survey results as public links, document exports, or AI reports with privacy checks and clear sharing details.
skill.author: webaskio

The skill describes requested WebAsk sharing workflows and requires explicit confirmation before publishing responses containing contact details. No evidence found of prompt injection, unauthorized data transfers, or malicious execution in the reviewed files; remote MCP implementations were not assessed.

content.value_statement: Sharing survey results requires choosing the right format and checking what recipients can see. This skill guides WebAsk tools to prepare links, exports, and AI reports with privacy checks.
actual_capabilities: Find a survey by name and clarify whether recipients need a summary, filtered report, individual responses, or AI analysis.
Prepare public links for summaries, reports, responses, and AI reports through WebAsk MCP tools.
Export summaries to PDF, filtered reports to PDF or Word, and individual responses to Excel.
Check survey structure for contact fields and require explicit confirmation before sharing those responses publicly.
Use date ranges, completion status, and saved report filters to select the intended results.
Request quantitative, comparative, or free-text AI analysis, retrieve the completed report, and share it as a link or PDF.
limitations: Requires access to the declared WebAsk MCP tools; this package does not implement the remote services.
Public result links remain active until revoked and show fresh data; export download links expire after one hour.
Privacy guidance does not guarantee automatic redaction or recipient-specific access control.
AI reports take time and require sufficient responses; the workflow stops when service limits prevent completion.

use_cases.title: Deliver client survey results
use_cases.description: Prepare a filtered report link or dated export while checking contact fields before releasing individual responses.

use_cases.title: Share ongoing feedback with leadership
use_cases.description: Create a live results link using the agreed date range and completion status for repeated review.

use_cases.title: Prepare survey findings for stakeholders
use_cases.description: Request AI analysis of quantitative results and free-text responses, then share the completed report when enough data is available.

prompt_templates.title: Share a survey summary
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the survey named [survey name] and prepare a public summary link. Tell me how long the link remains active.

prompt_templates.title: Export a filtered report
prompt_templates.prompt: Export a PDF report for [survey name] covering [start date] through [end date]. Include completed responses only and confirm the download expiry.

prompt_templates.title: Review response sharing
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare individual responses from [survey name] for sharing with [recipient]. Check for contact fields and ask for explicit confirmation before publishing them. Suggest a summary or report when appropriate.

prompt_templates.title: Generate stakeholder analysis
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an AI report for [survey name] with quantitative, comparative, and free-text analysis. Warn me if the data is insufficient and explain the generation delay. Retrieve the completed report and share it as a PDF.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate report generation, retrieval, and delivery.

output_examples.input: Share individual responses from a survey containing phone numbers.
output: A public response link would expose those numbers to anyone who has the link.
Would you like a summary instead, or do you explicitly approve sharing the responses publicly?

output_examples.input: Prepare a September PDF report with completed responses only.
output: Example delivery summary: PDF report for September.
The file captures results at export time.
The download link expires after one hour.

output_examples.input: Generate an AI report from ten responses.
output_examples.output: Ten responses are too few for reliable conclusions. I will not generate an AI report from this sample.

best_practices: Confirm the survey, recipient, date range, completion status, and output format before preparing results.
Check for contact fields and obtain explicit approval before publishing identifiable responses.
State applied filters and link expiry when delivering results; warn users before starting AI report generation.
anti_patterns: Publishing responses containing contact details without explicit confirmation.
Substituting a file for a requested link or treating a live link as a fixed snapshot.
Generating confident AI conclusions from a very small sample.

faq.question: What must be connected before using this skill?
faq.answer: The assistant needs access to the declared WebAsk MCP tools and the relevant survey. The skill provides instructions, not a standalone service.

faq.question: Which file formats are supported?
faq.answer: Summaries support PDF, filtered reports support PDF and Word, and individual responses support Excel. AI reports can be shared as PDF.

faq.question: How long do shared links last?
faq.answer: Public result links remain active until revoked and show updated data. File download links expire after one hour.

faq.question: Does the skill automatically remove personal information?
faq.answer: No automatic redaction is promised. It checks contact fields, suggests summaries or reports, and asks before publicly sharing responses containing contacts.

faq.question: Can I limit the report to selected responses?
faq.answer: Reports and responses support date and completion filters. The workflow also checks for saved report filters.

faq.question: What happens when AI analysis lacks data or reaches a limit?
faq.answer: The skill warns when there are too few responses. It reports service limits and stops without directing users to payment or upgrades.
